svg.text: At the same cap, MXBM leads on speed and efficiency between 210 W and 256 W -- and only there
RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, one session, runs interleaved and alternating. Caps set externally with nvidia-smi so neither miner's own
overclock code is a variable; power sampled from NVML for both, never from a miner's own stats block. 2 repeats per point.
Each miner's sol/s is its OWN definition and the two are not strictly comparable. The watts are one instrument for both.
